description: Source code for generating and sanitizing Swagger/OpenAPI specifications for an Express application, including fallback mechanisms and component building.

methods.name: buildCommonComponents
methods.description: Builds reusable components for the OpenAPI spec, including parameters and schemas.

methods.name: buildJsDocSpec
methods.description: Creates a Swagger spec from JSDoc annotations as a fallback.

methods.name: sanitizeOpenApiDoc
methods.description: Sanitizes an OpenAPI document by ensuring valid paths, required fields, and components.

methods.name: getBaseOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Main function to retrieve the base OpenAPI specification, loading from file or generating via JSDoc.
